common.build_description: GCC13 Release native O3 IPO/LTO; io_uring; test faults off

caveats: No concurrent builds or heavy tests during measurement.
1->1 and4->2 worker layouts keep source,target,client CPU sets disjoint on this8CPU host.
Uniform corpus is smaller to bound stop-and-wait runtime; compare variants within each case, not absolute throughput across corpora.
One writer at1large transaction/s has too few samples for a reliable p99 in short FULL runs; report count,max and distribution, not a strong tail-latency conclusion.
Real added RTT uses half-delay on each task-owned veth endpoint; actual measured target PING RTT is recorded.
Client samples include successful operations; compare completed QPS and requested rate, not requested rate alone.
Source CPU usage can be derived from samples.jsonl; peak RSS/queue metrics are sampled watermarks, not exact allocation peaks.
Mixed live runs can emit different total captured bytes because FULL duration changes the number of concurrent writes; report actual writes and frame bytes, not just requested rate.
Capture is disabled for all60runs. This later cohort cannot identify packet capture as the cause of prior differences.
10pairs improve observation counts but do not guarantee statistically stable p99; report per-run maxima, sample counts, distributions and paired FULL deltas.

declaration.reason: Complete no-capture live large-value 5/20ms and dense four-flow20ms comparisons; preserve input parameters, predeclare10 AB/BA pairs for each case, retain every outcome.
declaration.production_binaries: Same immutable main/chunks/records binaries as original report. CI fixes must be test-only to retain this provenance; revisit if production changes.
